jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.blurb: Own core ledger services handling millions of daily transactions.
jobs.desc: You'll own core ledger services processing millions of transactions a day. We're a small team (6 engineers) so you'll touch everything from schema design to on-call. Strong fundamentals in databases and concurrency matter more than any specific framework.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.blurb: Rebuild our merchant dashboard from the ground up.
jobs.desc: We're rebuilding our merchant dashboard from scratch - real-time charts, permissioned views, a lot of dense data made legible. React experience helps but we care more about your eye for interaction detail.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.blurb: Design end-to-end product flows for early-stage founder clients.
jobs.desc: You'll be the second designer on the team, working directly with founder clients across fintech and healthtech. Expect to run discovery, wireframe, and ship polished flows in the same week more often than you'd like.

jobs.title: Brand & Visual Designer
jobs.blurb: Shape visual identity systems for consumer-facing clients.
jobs.desc: Own visual identity work: logotype, type systems, colour, and the occasional pitch deck. You'll work closely with our product designers so systems thinking matters as much as taste.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer
jobs.blurb: Plan and run acquisition campaigns for 3-4 consumer brands.
jobs.desc: You'll run acquisition for 3-4 consumer brands at once: email, content, and light paid. We measure everything against one north-star metric per client and expect you to push back if a request doesn't serve it.

jobs.title: Content Strategist
jobs.blurb: Build content calendars that actually move the funnel.
jobs.desc: Plan and write content that ties directly to funnel stages, not just a calendar to fill. You'll work with the growth marketer on this account to keep everything pointed at one number.

challenges.title: Redesign a checkout flow
challenges.desc: Pick any e-commerce checkout you find frustrating and redesign it. Write up what was broken and why your version fixes it.

challenges.title: Build a rate limiter
challenges.desc: Describe (or pseudocode) a token-bucket rate limiter for a public API, including how you would handle bursty traffic.

challenges.title: 30-day growth plan for a DTC brand
challenges.desc: Sketch a 30-day acquisition plan for a hypothetical DTC skincare brand with a ₹50,000 budget and no existing audience.

challenges.title: Design a webhook retry system
challenges.desc: Meridian Labs challenge: outline how you would design retries and dead-lettering for outbound webhooks at scale.

submissions.text: I reworked a grocery app checkout by collapsing address, payment, and review into one scrollable screen with inline validation instead of three separate steps, cutting the taps needed to pay from 14 to 6.
A 30-day plan built around organic content in week 1-2 to seed an email list via a quiz funnel, then a small retargeting budget in week 3-4 once we have first-party data to target against.
